additional_sources.recommendation: Recommends it as one of Zion's best views and possibly its best short hike: about 1 mile round trip, ~160 ft elevation gain, allow 1-2 hours, trailhead just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, with epic views over Pine Creek Canyon and Zion's cliffs. Incredible at sunrise or sunset. Short but with exposed drop-offs, so keep kids close.
additional_sources.source_reel_theme: Best short hike / best view in Zion
additional_sources.source_title: Canyon Overlook Trail — One of Zion's Best Views

additional_sources.best_for: Short hike / Big view, Angels Landing alternative
additional_sources.recommendation: Recommends Canyon Overlook as the next best thing if you don't want Angels Landing's chains and climb or couldn't get a permit: about 1 mile round trip, about 20 minutes to the view and allow about an hour total, just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, past sandstone formations, rock alcoves and exposed sections. A short hike that delivers big views, worth adding to a Zion itinerary. Parking is very limited, so arrive early.
additional_sources.source_reel_theme: Short hike with an epic view, Angels Landing alternative
additional_sources.source_title: Canyon Overlook Trail — Epic View Without Angels Landing
